# Copilot Instructions for Precium

## Project Overview

This repository contains the Precium project, which appears to be related to price comparison and pricing functionality.

## General Guidelines

### Code Quality

- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
- Follow industry best practices for the programming languages and frameworks used
- Use descriptive variable and function names
- Add comments for complex logic or non-obvious implementations

### Testing

- Write tests for new features and bug fixes
- Ensure tests are clear and maintainable
- Run tests before committing changes

### Documentation

- Update README.md when adding new features or making significant changes
- Document API endpoints, functions, and modules
- Keep documentation up-to-date with code changes

### Git Workflow

- Write clear, descriptive commit messages
- Keep commits focused and atomic
- Reference issue numbers in commit messages when applicable

### Security

- Never commit sensitive information (API keys, passwords, tokens)
- Follow security best practices for the tech stack
- Validate and sanitize user inputs
- Handle errors gracefully without exposing sensitive information

## Code Style

- Follow consistent formatting throughout the project
- Use the project's existing code style and patterns
- Maintain consistency with surrounding code when making changes

## Pull Requests

- Provide clear descriptions of changes
- Include test results and validation steps
- Address review feedback promptly
- Keep PRs focused and reasonably sized
